title: Rita Coolidge: Anytime... Anywhere Album Cover
coreRelationships: The central portrait of the woman dominates the composition, drawing the eye directly.
The warm lighting on the woman's face and shoulders contrasts with the darker background and hair, creating depth.
The thin, light-colored border around the portrait separates it from the outer black frame.
The script typography at the top provides a delicate, elegant counterpoint to the strong central image.
The small logo at the bottom center acts as a subtle anchor for the overall design.
reuseFormula: Generate a warm, soft-focus portrait of a smiling woman with long dark hair, wearing tribal-inspired jewelry and clothing. Frame this portrait with a thin, light-colored border. Place this entire framed portrait against a solid black background. Overlay elegant, white script typography for the main titles at the top, split left and right with connecting lines. Add a small, white, geometric sans-serif logo at the bottom center.
